scope: Stable three-term OCS vector and four-term elevated point transformations when common normalization leaves a nonzero subnormal component.

finding.priorBehavior: A normalized coordinate can remain nonzero but subnormal, losing precision before compensated dot-product accumulation and rescaling.
finding.change: Both stable OCS dot paths now switch to the original exponent-range product route when a nonzero component normalizes to zero or a subnormal value. Opposite-sign products are combined first and multiplication residuals are included with compensated accumulation.
finding.scopeBoundary: The fallback is triggered for the demonstrated zero/subnormal normalization cases. It does not promise correctly rounded arithmetic for arbitrary finite coordinates.

unresolved: Correctly rounded behavior for arbitrary finite coordinate transforms is not established.
Native rendering and producer/platform qualification remain open.
claimEffect: Closes only the generated subnormal-normalization precision cases for HATCH/MPOLYGON OCS conversion. No DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
